## The question (1/20)

*State clearly your research question*

Woodlice have a very noticeable anti-predatory protective behaviour, this animals curl up into a ball and stay motionless during a certain period of time. Having this context in mind, we come up with the following research question: How different factors affect the time a woodlouse stays curled up?
